items.decision: Do not promote on current source evidence
findings: Goldman first sample is unreachable for its actual input; explanation silently changes the matrix.
Airbnb includes departure cell in obstacle checks; Goldman begins at the adjacent cell. Sources cannot be treated as equivalent for an obstructed start.
Neither source guarantees clear endpoints or explicitly settles a1x1 obstructed grid.
Existing Airbnb3 package publicly chooses obstructed endpoints=-1, including1x1. Its passing tests verify that chosen rule, not original-source uniqueness.
Both sources describe1..26 decoding counts but omit numeric length bounds.
decoding-string.md describes a different reversed ASCII decoding task. Its bounds cannot be borrowed.
An int return type alone does not bound input length or authorize modular arithmetic.
